reason_codes.rule-present: Exact managed resource has an accepted architecture rule.
reason_codes.composition-member: Exact managed resource is retained as a proven composition member rather than an independent service root.
reason_codes.configuration-or-helper: Managed resource configures another AWS service and has no independent architecture identity.
reason_codes.reviewed-no-independent-architecture-val: Coverage review found no durable architecture identity beyond an already modeled AWS service.
reason_codes.opaque-generic-resource: Generic AWS Cloud Control input hides the concrete resource schema and cannot be modeled honestly.
reason_codes.data-source-not-architecture-owner: Read-only lookup does not independently own Terraform architecture.
reason_codes.ephemeral-input-not-architecture-owner: Ephemeral provider operation does not own persistent architecture.
reason_codes.imperative-action-not-architecture: Provider action is an imperative side effect and not durable architecture.
reason_codes.list-query-not-source-architecture: List resource queries remote infrastructure for discovery/import and is not Terraform source architecture.
reason_codes.provider-function-not-architecture: Provider function is expression behavior, not a declaration.
reason_codes.resource-identity-protocol-metadata: Resource identity is provider protocol metadata, not a declaration.
reason_codes.catalog-rule-present: Reviewed architecture-owner surfaces have accepted semantics.
reason_codes.catalog-partial: Product has accepted semantics plus meaningful unmodeled surface.
reason_codes.catalog-configuration-only: Product has provider surface but no independent architecture root.
reason_codes.catalog-provider-surface-unmodeled: Product surface is present only through a construct with a precise current technical blocker.
reason_codes.no-provider-surface: Dated AWS product has no matching baseline provider surface.
